name: system-design
description: Turn a one-line system design exercise into a practice map instead of a finished answer: the few clarifying questions that change the architecture, the biggest hard-to-reverse forks ranked to the top with options and tipping signals, and a verdict on every element the design needs (onboarding, settings and per-customer configuration, tenancy, billing, queues, event streams, jobs, workflows, scale hot spots, security, operations, rollout). The learner works the design, with a hint ladder and a rubric review.
